items.title: 22.2 Acidity of Alcohols and Phenols (alcohols aur phenols ki acidity) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.2 with Quick Check 22.2 answered, printed pages 87-88 (PDF 90-91).

blocks.text: Alcohols ki dissociation (paani mein toot kar ions banna) bohat kam hoti hai. Yani paani mein ghulne par alcohol molecules zyada nahi toot'te. Equilibrium (tawazun) ki position left (baen) taraf rehti hai, yani RO⁻(aq) aur H⁺(aq) ions ke muqable mein alcohol molecules kahin zyada hote hain.

Paani jab dissociate hota hai to us ka equilibrium bhi left taraf rehta hai, lekin alcohols ke muqable mein H⁺ ions zyada bante hain. Alcohol ke solution mein [H⁺(aq)] paani se kam hoti hai, is liye alcohols paani se weak (kamzor) acids hain.

Alcohols ke paani se kam acidic hone ki wajah un ke alkyl groups hain. Alkyl groups electron donating (electron dene wale) groups hain. Aise groups covalent bond mein electrons ko dhakelte hain; is ko positive inductive effect kehte hain. Alcohol molecule se ek proton (H⁺) nikalne par alkoxide ion banta hai, aur alkyl group is ion ko destabilize (kam stable) karta hai: alkoxide ion ka oxygen electron dene wale alkyl group se jura hai, is liye O atom par electron density aur barh jati hai. Is wajah se alkoxide ion H⁺ ko dobara le kar phir se alcohol ban jane ki taraf zyada jhukaao rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: Displayed ethanol (aq) ethoxide ion (aq) + H+ (aq) ke saath equilibrium mein. Ethoxide ion mein C-C aur C-O- bonds par arrow ke nishan O- ki taraf. Do yellow (peele) boxes: 'position of the equilibrium lies to left' (equilibrium arrowon ki taraf ishara) aur 'alkyl group donates electron density towards O- which is more likely to accept H+ again to form CH3CH2OH' (H+ ki taraf ishara). Labels: ethanol, ethoxide ion, hydrogen ion.
blocks.caption: Dissociation of ethanol (ethanol ka ions mein tootna): ethanol, ethoxide ion aur hydrogen ion (kitab ke PDF page 90 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethoxide ion mein bonds par bane arrowheads (>) batate hain ke alkyl group electrons ko O⁻ ki taraf dhakelta hai (+I effect). Is se O⁻ par negative charge aur zyada ho jata hai, woh H⁺ ko wapas kheench kar ethanol bana leta hai, is liye equilibrium left taraf rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ke yellow box mein 'to from CH3CH2OH' chhapa hai.
Sahi: 'to form CH3CH2OH'.

Phenol mein bhi alcohol wala (-OH) group hai, phir bhi yeh weakly (halka sa) acidic hai. Is ki wajah yeh hai ke oxygen ka ek lone pair aromatic ring mein delocalise ho jata hai (phail jata hai). Yeh delocalisation phenoxide ion ko stable (mazboot) banati hai; phenoxide ion phenol ka conjugate base hai.

Aisa is liye hota hai ke oxygen ka ek lone pair ring ke delocalised π system se overlap karta hai. Is delocalisation ki wajah se oxygen atom par charge density kam ho jati hai. Is liye H⁺ ions phenoxide ion ki taraf zor se nahi khinchte aur dobara phenol molecule banane ka chance kam hota hai. Matlab phenol proton kho kar acid banne ki taraf zyada jhukaao rakhta hai, proton le kar base banne ki taraf nahi.

blocks.alt: Phenol (aq) phenoxide ion (aq), yani O- wala benzene ring, + H+ (aq) ke saath equilibrium mein. Labels: phenol, phenoxide ion.
blocks.caption: Dissociation of phenol (phenol ka ions mein tootna): phenol aur phenoxide ion (kitab ke PDF page 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Phenoxide ion: chhe grey carbon atoms ki ring, paanch chhote H atoms aur aik laal O atom. Carbon ring ke oopar aur neeche do blue (neele) rings extended pi system (phaila hua pi system) hain jo O tak pohanchte hain; O ke paas negative charge ka sign. O par do blue lobes '2 x sp2 - orbitals' hain.
blocks.caption: The negative charge on the oxygen is delocalised and spread on the aromatic ring making it a stable ion: oxygen ka negative charge aromatic ring par phail jata hai, is liye ion stable hai (kitab ke PDF page 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenoxide ion mein O ka ek lone pair p orbital mein hai jo ring ke π system se mil jata hai; blue rings dikhate hain ke π system ring se O tak phaila hua hai. Is tarah negative charge sirf O par nahi rehta, poore ring par phail jata hai aur ion stable hota hai. O ke baqi do lone pairs do sp² orbitals (blue lobes) mein hain jo ring ke plane (chapti satah) mein hain.
Relative acidity (acid hone ki taqat) ka order yeh hai: phenol > paani > ethanol.

blocks.prompt: i. Methanol aur ethanol ki relative acidic strength (acid hone ki taqat) ka comparison karein.
blocks.explanation: Methanol thora zyada acidic hai: ethanol ka ethyl group methyl group se zyada electron density oxygen ki taraf dhakelta hai, is liye ethoxide ion methoxide ion se kam stable hai.

rows: methoxide ion (CH₃O⁻) ke O par electron density kam
ethoxide ion (C₂H₅O⁻) ke O par electron density zyada
ethoxide ion kam stable, H⁺ jaldi wapas le leta hai

blocks.prompt: ii. Electron delocalisation dikha kar samjhayein ke phenoxide ion (PhO⁻) ethoxide ion (C₂H₅O⁻) se zyada stable kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Phenoxide mein negative oxygen ka lone pair ring ke π system se overlap karta hai, is liye charge oxygen aur ring par phail jata hai. Ethoxide mein charge sirf oxygen par rehta hai aur ethyl group us par aur electron density dhakelta hai.

rows: O ka lone pair ring ke π system se overlap karta hai
koi π system nahi, overlap nahi
negative charge O aur ring par phail jata hai (delocalised)
ring electrons ko O se door kheenchti hai
ethyl group (+I) O ki taraf electrons dhakelta hai

blocks.prompt: iii. Alkali metals strong (taqatwar) acids se react kar ke hydrogen gas dete hain. Sodium ka ek tukra do beakers mein dala jata hai, ek mein ethanol aur doosre mein phenol. (a) Kis beaker mein hydrogen gas pehle aur tezi se niklegi? (b) Agar sodium dalne se pehle phenolphthalein indicator maujood ho to kaun sa solution pehle pink hoga?
blocks.explanation:
(a) Phenol wale beaker mein, kyun ke phenol ethanol se zyada strong acid hai.
(b) Ethanol wala: is mein banne wala sodium ethoxide strong base hai aur phenolphthalein ko pink kar deta hai. Sodium phenoxide weak base hai, aur bacha hua phenol us ke saath mil kar solution ko zyada basic nahi hone deta.

items: Alcohols paani se weak acids hain: alkyl group alkoxide ion ko destabilize karta hai.
Phenol weakly acidic hai: phenoxide ion mein charge ring par phail kar ion ko stable karta hai.
